summary: Nebius Group N.V. (Nasdaq: NBIS) filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of MagicByte, Inc. (d/b/a Eigen AI Labs), a leading inference and model optimization company. The transaction was announced on May 1, 2026, and closed on June 10, 2026, following receipt of required regulatory approvals and satisfaction of customary closing conditions. No financial terms were disclosed. The acquisition was completed in under six weeks, indicating a relatively straightforward process. Watch for integration updates and potential accretion/dilution commentary in Nebius's next earnings release.
